entries.title: It's weird that most of “Hacker” news is dominated by business news
entries.author: greendude29
entries.current_title: It's weird that most of “Hacker” news is dominated by business news
entries.excerpt: I know that "tech" is all about startups and business success, but I'd like to see conversations about software, hardware, computer science, and hacker culture resurge and dominate here. Of course HN is run by YC so there will always be the mod posts about startups and jobs, but it seems the community here sometimes tilts more towards business than technology. Just a personal thought, would like to hear if others also have a similar perception.
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者觉得 HN 商业新闻过多，希望看到更多围绕软件和技术本身的讨论。

entries.title: Thank HN: 7 years and $7M later, it all started right here

entries.title: Project Gutenberg is no longer fully blocked in Germany
entries.author: Vespasian
entries.current_title: Project Gutenberg is no longer fully blocked in Germany
entries.excerpt: They settled their 2015 lawsuit and will only be blocking these specific works. More information and Background: https://cand.pglaf.org/germany/index.html

entries.title: VSCode deprecates Enable Telemetry, auto-enrolls you in Telemetry?
entries.author: tmpfile
entries.current_title: VSCode deprecates Enable Telemetry, auto-enrolls you in Telemetry?
entries.excerpt: VSCode has deprecated "Enable Telemetry" and now auto-enrolls you into their new Telemetry option even if you've disabled all the previous telemetry settings. Screenshot https://imgur.com/a/nxvH8cW The changes apply to the most recent version of vscode (version 1.61.0 released Oct 7).
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者质疑 VS Code 遥测设置变更是否会把此前退出的用户重新纳入。

entries.title: Ask HN: Whatever happened to exploring the internet?
entries.author: mickjagger
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Whatever happened to exploring the internet?
entries.excerpt: I seem to have collapsed down to checking 5 to 6 sites. Where would I even go to find other sites that might be of interest? I can’t even really think of any other sites to visit. Whatever happened to the idea of “exploring the Internet”?
entries.guide_zh: 每天只浏览固定几个网站，怎样重新找回探索互联网的乐趣？
